usedFor: Product hunt surfaces launches, and Google Docs keeps a log of them through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a product becomes hot” in Product hunt, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A product reaching the hot threshold is written into a tab, so you track what is taking off.

watchOut: The trigger is polling, and “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace content, so pick adding to keep history.
